coverage.rule: A value from a row whose coverage is under 50% is withheld: null, with a reason next to it.

provenance.definition: Announced elevator and escalator outages per station
sql: select distinct station_id as id, station_name as name from read_parquet('<gold_snapshot>/gold/agg_accessibility_outages.parquet') order by name, id

select station_id, station_name, lines, case when coalesce(coverage_pct, 0) >= 50 then n_outages end as n_outages, case when coalesce(coverage_pct, 0) >= 50 then n_elevator_outages end as n_elevator_outages, case when coalesce(coverage_pct, 0) >= 50 then n_escalator_outages end as n_escalator_outages, round(case when coalesce(coverage_pct, 0) >= 50 then outage_hours end, 1) as outage_hours, currently_out, n_currently_out, round(longest_open_outage_h, 1) as longest_open_outage_h, current_outage_text, round(coverage_pct, 1) as coverage_pct, not (coalesce(coverage_pct, 0) >= 50) as withheld from read_parquet('<gold_snapshot>/gold/agg_accessibility_outages.parquet') where window_label = 'last_24h' and list_contains(lines, 'Blue') and (currently_out or coalesce(n_outages, 0) > 0) order by currently_out desc, outage_hours desc nulls last, station_name, station_id limit 501
